title: Open Climate Risk
description: Open Climate Risk is a CarbonPlan project providing building-level wildfire risk assessments across the continental United States. It integrates USFS wildfire hazard raster inputs with Overture Maps building footprints and Census TIGER/Line boundaries to compute risk metrics at building, Census block, tract, and county scales. Outputs are distributed as Hive-partitioned Geoparquet, PMTiles, Icechunk tensor stores, GPKG, and CSV files.

## README.md
# Open Climate Risk

This Source Cooperative repository contains data products for the [Open Climate Risk](https://carbonplan.org/research/climate-risk) project. These data were used to build a scalable pipeline for calculating climate risk assessments at building-level resolution across the continental United States. Wildfire risk was calculated through a distributed processing system that can run locally or on cloud infrastructure. Technical documentation can be found [here](https://docs.carbonplan.org/ocr).

## Working with the data
Documentation for working with the raster and vector data can be found [here](https://docs.carbonplan.org/ocr/en/latest/how-to/work-with-data.html).

## Data Formats

**Tensor** 
- Our raw input data consisted of either Zarr or TIFF files. We processed it into rechunked Icechunk stores. 
- Our n-dimensional output data is stored as a single Icechunk store. 

**Vector**
- Our raw input data was either GPKG or Geoparquet. All the vector pipeline inputs were converted to Geoparquet.
- Our output vector data is stored in multiple formats. See [our documentation on data access](https://docs.carbonplan.org/ocr/en/latest/access-data.html) for more details.
    - Hive-partitioned (state/county) Geoparquet file for risk sampled buildings across CONUS. 
    - PMTiles layers for buildings, Census blocks, Census Tracts and counties.
    - Summary statistics files in GPKG and CSV

## Data structure

The data is split into `inputs` and `outputs,` where `inputs` are raw and processed data for the pipeline, and `outputs` are versioned dataset outputs.

```bash
├── input
│   └── fire-risk
│       ├── tensor
│       │   ├── USFS (Icechunk & TIFF)
│       │   │   ├── dillon-et-al-2023 
│       │   │   ├── riley-et-al-2025 
│       │   │   └── scott-et-al-2024 
│       │   └── conus404-ffwi (Icechunk)
│       └── vector
│           ├── census-tiger (Geoparquet)
│           │   ├── LICENSE.txt (CC BY 4.0) 
│           │   ├── blocks 
│           │   ├── counties
│           │   └── tracts
│           └── overture-maps (Geoparquet)
│                └── LICENSE.txt (ODbL)
└── output
    └── fire-risk
        ├── tensor (Icechunk)
        │   ├── LICENSE.txt (CC BY 4.0)
        │   ├── NOTICE.txt
        │   └── production
        └── vector (Geoparquet, PMTiles, GPKG, csv)
            ├── LICENSE.txt (ODbL)
            ├── NOTICE.txt
            └── production

```

## Data Sources

The tensor outputs rely on data from [K Riley et al. 2025](https://doi.org/10.2737/RDS-2025-0006), [J Scott et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.2737/RDS-2020-0016-2), and [R Rasmussen et al. 2023](https://doi.org/10.1175/BAMS-D-21-0326.1). The vector outputs additionally incorporate data from the [Overture Maps Foundation buildings dataset](https://docs.overturemaps.org/guides/buildings/) and [Census TIGER/Line](https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/tiger-line-file.html). Read more about our data sources [here](https://docs.carbonplan.org/ocr/en/latest/reference/data-sources.html). 


## Terms of use

By viewing Open Climate Risk data, you agree to CarbonPlan’s [Terms of Use](https://carbonplan.org/terms) and [Privacy Policy](https://carbonplan.org/privacy).

This work contains information from the Overture Maps buildings database, which is made available here under the [Open Database License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl) (ODbL).

Licenses for tensor ([CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0)) and vector ([ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0)) data are packaged with the data in colocated LICENSE.txt files.
